notes.title: Nyran Survivors Version 6.0
notes.content:
Hello Mediators,

With version 6, I decided to hold off on updating the game over smaller patches and make this update one giant patch. That's why it was a little quiet for some time.

Anyway, on to version 6! It's a big patch, lots of stuff got added and lots of stuff got fixed. Below is the changelog. 

[h1]Introducing, the Gunslinger[/h1]
The Gunslinger – a new class wielding dual pistols. Unlockable after defeating The Interstice's final boss, this addition expands the playable classes to a total of [b]11[/b].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/8ec392232af18c96a822bf5a99ed268314da76bb.png[/img]

[h1]New map, Oleand Coast[/h1]
Venture to Oleand Coast to defeat [b]6[/b] new bosses and new enemies. This map is automatically unlocked after defeating the last boss of The Interstice and is geared towards classes that have reached upgrade level 40.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/73f1a8dd05bfb4ed19a2e3ba4836c2b41fe919d4.png[/img]

[h1]New Items[/h1]
[b]2[/b] new items have been added. Critical Strike chance + Cooldown reduction item and a healing item.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/a0b15437e403f6635bd59143067874423fb5f59b.png[/img]

[h1]New Spells[/h1]
Version 6 has [b]3[/b] new spells to add to your builds.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/45188d78d0f302114faa2b5850509fdd0c044bd4.png[/img]

[h1]Better Feedback[/h1]
The screen will flash red showing some feedback every time you get hit. This option can be turned off via the settings and is on by default. There is also a highlight outline that can be turned on, in case you lose your character. This setting is turned off by default and can be turned on via the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/54000dd3a27929e3e2fcf4b359db804fd3e9a645.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Map[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Oleand Coast
[/list]

[h2]Class[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gunslinger
[/list]

[h3]Assassin[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base Critical Damage increased to 12%, up from 10%
[/list]

[h3]Ranger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bow Shot damage increased by 10%
[*] Bow Shot projectile speed increased to 25m/s, up from 20m/s
[*] Multi Shot projectile speed increased to 25m/s, up from 20m/s
[*] Multi Shot cone reduced slightly
[*] Bowshot multiple projectiles now spawns at the same time
[*] Bowshot spell hit sound effect changed
[*] Multi Shot spell hit sound effect added
[/list]

[h3]Elementalist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Earth Toss can now have multiple projectiles
[*] Earth Toss point light removed
[*] Frost Orb damage increased by 5%
[/list]

[h3]Druid[/h3]
[list]
[*] Nature Bolt projectile speed increased to 20m/s, up from 16m/s
[*] Nature Bolt combo finisher has a new animation
[/list]

[h3]Death Knight[/h3]
[list]
[*] Base Vitality increased to 105, up from 95
[/list]

[h3]Brood Mother[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spiderling Swarm now explodes when reaches the end of its spell range
[/list]

[h2]Spells[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Explosive Chicken
[*] Dragon Punch
[*] Abyssal Rain
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Strike Again cone angle reduced slightly
[*] Volatile Spiderling now explodes when reaches the end of its spell range
[*] Frost Pillar damage increased by 10%
[*] Dagger Throw range increased by 10%
[*] All Wave spells damage increased by 20%
[*] Hermes Boots spell duration increased to 14s, up from 10s
[*] Shields Up! spell duration increased to 12s, up from 10s
[/list]

[h2]Items[/h2]
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Demon Heart epic item added, gain 2% crit and 2% cooldown
[*] Cherry Pie rare item added, heal 20% hp
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pancakes now give 40% health, up from 20%
[/list]

[h2]Engine[/h2]
[list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[*] Gold value now shows when picking up gold items
[*] Added a new option to settings that will now flash the screen when you take damage. This setting is on by default
[*] Added a new option to settings that will now highlight the player. This setting is off by default
[*] Added treasure goblin achievements

[*] There is now a limit on the number of damage numbers that can be showed at once. This caused a lot of lag at end game. Player damage numbers bypass this limit
[*] Health bars of enemies with Weakness applied will now show as purple
[*] Normal damage numbers delete time slightly reduced
[*] Main Menu UI important text is now highlighted in yellow
[*] Enemies no longer get knocked back if the spell will kill them

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[*] Language fixes
[*] Fixed an issue with missing scripts on Windmere Pass level
[*] Fixed a bug with missing shaders and materials on elite/boss ragdolls (purple textures)
[*] Fixed a bug with deletion effect of enemies at the end of the round
[*] Deletion effect sound effect at the end of the round will now respect its audio settings volume
[*] Fixed a display issue with the game timer when retrying the map

[*] Fixed a visual bug with mob spawning boss spells
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!

notes.title: Nyran Survivors 2.0 Released!
notes.content:
Hello Mediators,

I hope you all are enjoying playing Nyran Survivors so far. I see a few videos online about it, really cool! It's really nice to hear from the players and watching them play (and fail!).

This patch aims to sort out some issues, let's get started.

[h2]Keybinds are here[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/0b0658859ffba4743ddc53bf56d730eb99d33ed1.png[/img]
There was no way to get around the hardcoded keybinds in Nyran Survivors. Well, not anymore. In the settings, see the new keybinds screen to change keybinds. 

I got a few DM's about people wanting to change their keys from WASD or they couldn't play the game because they are using AZERTY keyboards. I hope this will help now.

[h2]Changes to item/spell rerolls[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/41c54a78277b1268a04d0f844413f73f1a1b023c.png[/img]
Before version 2, there was an unlimited amount of item and spell rerolls. This is fun and all but as we have leaderboards, this makes it less competitive. I see a few people who have over 500+ item rerolls (sus) which is unfair to those are a legitimately trying to rank. 

It also helps to keep it competitive as you now only have 100 rerolls to compete on the board. With these changes, leaderboards have been adjusted and rankings with over 100 item/spell rerolls have been removed.

[h2]Changes to levels[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796467/4a825156ce0de49e0d4c55dda979a83fdb885907.png[/img]
Again, there was no cap on levels, the game just kept levelling you up so you can earn more and more items and spells. Not anymore. There is now a level limit of 100, however you can level past this but the rewards will only be healing or extra gold. 

Upon reaching level 100, elites now have slightly more health.

With this change, leaderboard rankings that have more than 100 player levels have been removed.

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Keybinds have been added, see settings menu
[*] Elites have increased health when player reaches level 100
[*] Item and spell reroll now has a limit of 100 rerolls
[*] Fixed a bug that caused item/spell rerolls to not take the proper amount of gold
[*] Pancakes item added
[*] Treasure Chest item added
[*] Shield Wall spell now has an active effect
[*] Shield Wall spell duration increased to 3s, up from 2.5s
[*] Forced Vsync on whilst in main menu to help AMD users
[/list]


Thank you for your continued support, see you on the leaderboards!
